does: Collects the roller's reroll boosts that match the roll's type, as pairs of the face at or below which a die is thrown again and whether the new die always stands, sorted by that face.

evidence.says: It walks the roller's boosts of the reroll kind and compares the roll type, the umbrella types through two helpers
A count-only probe on it shows one call for each roll with boosts, from code:eoc::roll::stream::RollManager::InternalRollDiceWithBoosts
With the passive Halfling Luck on the roller the roll that follows throws its natural 1 again; without it the same function is called and no die is thrown again
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.

questions.ask: A natural 1 of a roller with Halfling Luck
questions.answer: With Halfling Luck on the roller the natural 1 is thrown again; without it the function is still called and no die is thrown again.
